sources.title: City of Burien — Permit Application Information
sources.supports: Permit submittals only accepted through MyBuildingPermit (fire permits current exception); contractors need state license + City of Burien endorsement via WA DOR, verified before any permit issued; utility applications approved by provider prior to submittal and uploaded on MyBuildingPermit; permittech@burienwa.gov.

sources.title: City of Burien — Submittal Checklists
sources.supports: Lists 2021 Residential Prescriptive Energy Code Worksheet, Whole House Ventilation Worksheet, Residential Structures checklist, Residential Uncovered Deck and Porch Guide, critical-area checklists (CARA, FWHCA, Geologically Hazardous, Streams, Wetland), Septic and Private Water System Checklist, Seattle City Light service links; 400 SW 152nd St Ste 300; (206) 241-4647.

sources.title: City of Burien — Residential Structures Submittal Checklist (PDF)
sources.supports: Applied for online at MyBuildingPermit; application contents incl. state contractor license copy and Burien business license number; energy code form; water/fire hydrant/sewer availability forms; stamped structural calcs; geotech if applicable; GIS AutoCAD site plans if adding 2000 sf+; 1/4in=1ft on 11x17; site plan items; foundation connection details new to existing; height above average natural grade; 500 sf addition triggers energy code + indoor air quality; noise reduction zones for new and moved structures; FEMA flood elevation certificate; Small Project Drainage Review if any impervious surface added (BMC 13.10, KCSWDM App C); tree permit/retention/planting (BMC 19.26).

sources.title: City of Burien — Construction Permit Application Information (PDF)
sources.supports: Applications, payments, inspections via MyBuildingPermit; list of work not requiring a building permit (200 sf sheds, decks <=30in, retaining walls <=4ft no surcharge, finish work, etc.); permit tech (206) 241-4647; fees by scope, plan review fees based on fair market value; review goals single-family addition 3 wk initial comments / 3 wk resubmittal / 6 wk target issuance.

sources.title: Washington L&I — City electrical permits and inspections
sources.supports: Burien (400 SW 152nd St Ste 300, 206-439-3157) listed among cities issuing their own electrical permits.
